female / (female + male) homicide rate. Country-year shocks that affect homicide recording in general cancel out of this ratio, so it isolates the sex-specific component the Convention targets.

log(female rate) - log(male rate). The difference-in-differences estimand on this outcome is a triple difference: it nets out any country-year change in homicide levels or recording common to both sexes.
